description:
List the trademarks and trading names that the Spanish patent office (OEPM)
records under a holder with this company's name.

Use it for a known company (a slug from search_companies or
company_history); to go from a brand to its company use brand_owner.

Returns JSON {company_slug, commercial_names, trademarks (each {name, file,
status, since}), counts, truncated, limit_per_kind, source, note}. The
office publishes no tax IDs, so every link is a name match, not
confirmed ownership. An empty result means none is linked in our data,
not that the company holds none; {error, suggested_companies} means no
company was found with that slug, so nothing was looked up. limit applies to each kind separately,
newest first; counts is what this answer lists, not the company's total,
and truncated true for a kind means more are linked: raise limit.

Read-only; one request per call. Needs the basic plan or higher: send your
API key in the X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

company.description: Company slug, as returned by search_companies or company_history, e.g. vaz-metales-sl.
company.title: Company

limit.description: Maximum results per kind (trademarks, trading names), integer 1-200, e.g. 10 (default 50).
limit.title: Limit
